title: Cancellation rate
statementMd:
What percentage of orders were cancelled? Round to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `cancelled_pct`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Average a 0/1 flag, or divide counts.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS cancelled_pct FROM orders;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
